title: Controlled Model Debiasing through Minimal and Interpretable Updates
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmarks and experiments focus on algorithmic fairness concerning the sensitive attribute of 'race' in the Law School and Compas datasets.
models_tested: Logistic Regression (as the base biased model)
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
